field_tiers.doc: Fields this domain writes onto other domains' entities (cleaning cloths, mop pads, rugs, bags it launders; beds it dresses; items found in pockets or buried in bedding) and onto rooms: laundry bookkeeping and model numbers are hidden, a bed's made state is visible at a glance, the bed summary's exact wrinkle and offset numbers are hidden (the inspector shows them as a look), sizes after shrink/stretch need a tape measure.

textile.doc: Anything made of fabric that can be laundered, folded, hung or dried.

view.doc: A sewn-in care label's print is about 2.5 mm high: legible only up close (the wrist camera, or the item held); a size tag's 4 mm.

garment.doc: Clothing worn by a person (owner, size, season, care label).

dress_shirt.doc: Woven cotton button-down shirt (hang-preferred, wrinkles easily).

blouse.doc: Silk blouse: hand wash cold, line dry, cool iron, slippery on wire hangers.

sweater.doc: Wool knit sweater: hand wash cold, dry flat, never tumble (felts and shrinks), hang stretches it.

cashmere_sweater.doc: Fine cashmere knit (very delicate; comb pills, never shave).

hoodie.doc: Cotton fleece hoodie with a kangaroo pocket (thick seams dry slowly).

jeans.doc: Dark denim jeans (wash inside out cold, thick seams dry last).

dress_pants.doc: Pressed dress trousers (polyester-wool; keep the crease, hang by the cuffs or fold on the crease).

dress.doc: Rayon day dress (hand wash cold, hang to dry, hang in the long section).

evening_gown.doc: Long gown (hem needs the long-hang section).

suit_jacket.doc: Structured wool suit jacket (dry clean; wide-shoulder hanger).

coat.doc: Heavy wool winter coat (1.8 kg; dry clean; sturdy wide hanger).

light_jacket.doc: Light polyester jacket for mild days.

underwear.doc: Cotton briefs/boxers (intimate: handle minimally, owner's pile only).

bra.doc: Molded-cup bra with hook-and-eye closure (mesh bag, hand/delicate wash, never tumble, nest - never fold).

sock.doc: Single sock; pairs share a secret pair_id (length, size and brand mark distinguish look-alikes).

child_sleepwear.doc: Children's flame-resistant polyester sleepwear (no softener or dryer sheets).

swimsuit.doc: Spandex swimsuit (rinse chlorine, hand wash cold, never tumble).

brimmed_hat.doc: Structured felt hat with a brim (crushes under weight; spot clean only).

baseball_cap.doc: Cotton cap with a stiff brim.

glove.doc: One glove (left or right); pairs share a secret pair_id.

belt.doc: Leather belt (roll or hang; not laundered).

necktie.doc: Silk necktie (dry clean; roll or hang).

towel.doc: Cotton terry towel (lint shedder; hot wash; softener cuts absorbency).

kitchen_towel.doc: Flat-weave cotton dish towel (kitchen hygiene class).

workout_towel.doc: Microfiber gym towel (no softener, low heat).

bath_mat.doc: Cotton-top bath mat with rubber/latex backing (cold gentle wash, tumble low or line dry; hot dryer crumbles the backing).

view.doc: The care label is sewn on the back: it faces the floor while the mat lies there.

memory_foam_bath_mat.doc: Memory-foam bath mat: hand wash only; machine washing destroys it.

coir_doormat.doc: Coir doormat with PVC backing: shake/brush or light rinse, never machine-wash or soak.

outdoor_mat.doc: Polypropylene outdoor mat: hose and scrub outside.

fitted_sheet.doc: Fitted sheet: elastic corner pockets (35 cm deep); seams face down; queen 152 x 203 cm.

flat_sheet.doc: Flat (top) sheet with a wide hem at the head; print side goes down; queen 229 x 259 cm.

pillowcase.doc: Standard pillowcase 51 x 76 cm (a folded sheet set can be stored inside one).

pillow_sham.doc: Decorative flanged sham (often delicate; follow its label).

pillow_protector.doc: Zippered pillow protector (goes under the pillowcase).

duvet_cover.doc: Duvet cover with button closure (closure_open) and corner ties; queen 229 x 218 cm.

duvet_insert.doc: Down duvet insert (machine bulky/gentle in a large drum, tumble low with dryer balls; dries slowly).

fleece_blanket.doc: Polyester fleece blanket (machine wash cold, tumble low).

knit_throw.doc: Chunky knit throw (stretches if hung by a corner).

quilt.doc: Cotton patchwork quilt (heirloom ones are sentimental).

mattress_protector.doc: Waterproof (polyurethane-membrane) mattress protector: quilted side up, warm wash, no bleach, tumble low.

decorative_pillow.doc: Decorative throw pillow 45 x 45 cm with a zipper.

cushion_cover.doc: Zippered cushion cover (wash the matching set together cold/gentle; dryer heat shrinks it).

tablecloth.doc: Linen tablecloth 150 x 260 cm (for a 6-seat table: ~30-40 cm drop).

vinyl_tablecloth.doc: Vinyl wipe-clean tablecloth (no machine wash, no heat).

shower_curtain.doc: Polyester fabric shower curtain with 12 grommets (rings stay on the rod).

shower_curtain_liner.doc: PEVA shower liner (cold gentle wash, never in the dryer; hangs inside the tub).

press_cloth.doc: Cotton press cloth for ironing darks, wool and synthetics.

shoelace.doc: Shoelace (120 cm default; aglets on both ends).

shoe.doc: One shoe (left/right); pairs share a secret pair_id. Materials decide care.

sneaker.doc: Canvas sneaker, 6 eyelet pairs, criss-cross laced (label may allow a cold gentle wash in a bag).

running_shoe.doc: Mesh running shoe with foam sole (hand clean, never tumble).

dress_shoe.doc: Smooth-leather oxford, 5 eyelet pairs bar-laced (polish and buff).

boot.doc: Leather ankle boot (shaft crushes under weight).

suede_boot.doc: Suede boot (brush/eraser only; water marks it, polish ruins the nap).

sandal.doc: Summer sandal (open straps: watertight false, kernel pours, spills, drips and rain run off it instead of pooling in its 1 l shoe room).

washing_machine.doc: Clothes washer: drum (container) + programs; door locks while running; see systems/textiles_laundry/wash.py.

view.doc: An opaque cabinet with a front (or top) opening. A glass porthole door shows the drum while closed in geometric camera mode (the domain marks a glass_door washer transparent there; the body stays opaque). The display shows 10 mm characters; the capacity is on the rating label inside the door (4 mm), the electrical rating in 2.5 mm print.

front_load_washer.doc: Front-loading HE washer (8 kg, 65 L drum, 1400 rpm, glass door).

top_load_washer.doc: Traditional top-loading washer with agitator (9 kg, 110 L tub, lid lock only during spin).

clothes_dryer.doc: Vented tumble dryer (9 kg, 120 L drum); lint screen slot; door opens anytime (pauses).

view.doc: An opaque cabinet with a front door (a glass_door dryer shows its drum while closed in geometric mode, as a washer does). 10 mm display; 4 mm rating label inside the door.

washer_dispenser.doc: Washer detergent drawer, a part of its washer (relation part; open it to reach the prewash/main/softener/bleach compartments).

dispenser_compartment.doc: One dispenser compartment (liquid container; the softener one has a MAX line).

washer_drain_filter.doc: Front-loader drain-pump filter (behind the kick-plate cover; ~1-2 L of water comes out).

lint_screen.doc: Dryer lint screen (pull out, peel lint off by hand; wash off softener film; refit dry).

props.label: laundry detergent
props.label_text: HE liquid detergent. Normal load: fill cap to line 1 (30 mL); large/heavily soiled: line 3 (45 mL). Pour into the MAIN compartment.

liquid_detergent.doc: HE liquid laundry detergent, 2.5 L (~30 mL per normal load; cap has dose lines). The laundry_jug look-alike group's common jug: 15 x 10 x 28 cm HDPE with a handle and a 4 cm screw neck (mouth_frac 0.3), 0.17 kg empty, 2.95 L brim; every member carries the same jug props.

props.label: free & clear detergent
props.label_text: Free & Clear HE liquid detergent - no dyes or perfumes. Normal load: fill cap to line 1 (30 mL). Pour into the MAIN compartment.

props.label: regular detergent
props.label_text: Regular (non-HE) detergent. 60 mL per load. Not for high-efficiency machines.

detergent_pod.doc: Single-dose detergent pod (put in the drum before the clothes).

props.label: fabric softener
props.label_text: Fabric softener. Pour to line 1 (30 mL) in the SOFTENER compartment, never directly on clothes. Not for microfiber, towels that must stay absorbent, athletic wear or children's sleepwear.

fabric_softener.doc: Liquid fabric softener, 2.5 L in the laundry_jug group's common jug (softener compartment up to MAX; not for towels/microfiber/athletic/FR wear).

props.label: chlorine bleach
props.label_text: Chlorine bleach (sodium hypochlorite). DANGER: corrosive. Never mix with vinegar, ammonia or other cleaners. Whites only: 1/3 cup (80 mL) in the BLEACH compartment.

chlorine_bleach_bottle.doc: Chlorine laundry bleach, 2.5 L in the laundry_jug group's common jug (bleach compartment only; never with ammonia/acids; keep out of children's reach). The type name's noun would give it the kernel's bottle row (a round, narrow-necked cylinder): shape, com_frac and mouth_frac are set to the jug's.

props.label: oxygen laundry booster
props.label_text: Oxygen laundry booster (non-chlorine, colour-safe). Add 1 scoop (30 mL) to the drum or presoak in warm water.

oxygen_laundry_booster.doc: Oxygen (percarbonate) laundry booster, 2.5 L in the laundry_jug group's common jug (colour-safe; tannin stains; soaks).

props.label: stain remover spray
props.label_text: Pretreat: spray both sides, work in gently, wait 5-10 minutes, wash. Do not let dry. Not for silk, wool, leather or dry-clean-only items.

stain_remover_spray.doc: Enzyme stain-remover spray (not for silk, wool, leather or dry-clean-only; dwell 5-10 min, never let it dry).

props.label: enzyme presoak
props.label_text: Enzyme presoak for protein stains (blood, egg, milk, grass). Soak in COOL water 30 minutes to overnight. Not for wool or silk.

enzyme_presoak.doc: Enzyme presoak liquid, 2.5 L in the laundry_jug group's common jug (protein/grass stains; cold water).

dryer_sheet.doc: One scented dryer sheet (in the drum on top of the load - never on the lint screen).

dryer_sheet_box.doc: Box of dryer sheets (a paperboard carton with a pull slot: watertight false, kernel pours, spills, drips and rain soak through it instead of pooling).

wool_dryer_ball.doc: Wool dryer ball (fragrance-free softening, ~10 % faster drying).

washer_cleaner_tablet.doc: Washer cleaner tablet (empty drum, tub-clean cycle).

clothes_hanger.doc: Clothes hanger (hanger_kind, hang_load_kg, non_slip, wide_shoulder, clips, notches).

wire_hanger.doc: Thin wire hanger (bends under heavy coats; silk slides off).

wooden_hanger.doc: Contoured wooden suit/coat hanger (wide shoulders, 4 kg).

velvet_hanger.doc: Slim flocked non-slip hanger (velvet flocking grips about as well as rubber: friction 1.0 against finished wood).

padded_hanger.doc: Padded satin hanger for delicates (the padding grips: friction 0.8).

drying_rack.doc: Folding accordion drying rack: open = unfolded and locked (1.0 x 0.5 m, 10 rails, flat mesh top, 15 kg wet load).

view.doc: An empty accordion rack is thin rails: most of the view passes. In geometric mode the record's view porosity follows the laundry hung on it (dry.refresh_rack_view).

towel_bar.doc: Wall towel bar 60 cm (spreads a towel to dry, unlike a single hook).

clothesline.doc: Outdoor clothesline 6 m between posts at 1.8 m (needs pins against wind). Rated about 20 kg of hung laundry (two full washer loads wet; household lines and rotary dryers are sold for 15-25 kg): the hang rating the kernel's hang law reads.

ironing_board.doc: Folding ironing board: stored folded (0.38 x 0.1 m, 1.37 m long) hung on wall hooks, stood upright or in a closet; open = set up on its legs at 0.9 m (1.2 x 0.38 m surface, an obstacle on the floor). Nothing can be laid on it folded; it is folded only when empty.

view.doc: Set up, a 4 cm board on splayed legs: the space under it stays open.

clothes_iron.doc: Steam iron (dial low 110 / medium 150 / high 200 / max 220 C; 0.3 L tank; auto-off 30 s face-down, 8 min on heel).

garment_steamer.doc: Handheld garment steamer (0.26 L tank, MAX 0.25 L; ~45 s to heat).

lint_roller.doc: Adhesive lint roller (60 sheets; peel a sheet when saturated).

clothes_brush.doc: Natural-bristle clothes brush (brush with the nap).

fabric_shaver.doc: Battery fabric shaver (sturdy knits only; lint chamber fills).

hamper.doc: Lidded laundry hamper (70 L; owner's dirty clothes).

view.doc: Looked into from above with its lid open.

sorter_hamper.doc: Three-bag sorter hamper (lights / darks / colors sections).

view.doc: A steel frame holding open-topped fabric bags: looked into from above.

hamper_section.doc: One bag of a sorter hamper (a fabric bag: watertight false, kernel pours, spills, drips and rain run through it to the floor instead of pooling in its 40 l).

view.doc: An open-topped fabric bag hung in the sorter's frame: looked into from above.

mesh_laundry_bag.doc: Zippered mesh laundry bag (protects delicates, halves agitation).

laundry_bag.doc: Drawstring cotton laundry bag (40 L, 0.25 kg).

garment_bag.doc: Breathable canvas garment bag for coats and formal wear (0.6 x 1.1 m, about 12 cm deep holding a coat; 0.45 kg).

wash_basin.doc: Plastic laundry basin for soaking (15 L).

umbrella_stand.doc: Umbrella stand with a drip tray.

moth_repellent.doc: Cedar block / lavender sachet for stored woollens.

shoe_polish.doc: Tin of wax shoe polish (colour black/brown/neutral).

shoe_brush.doc: Horsehair shoe brush (brush off dirt, buff polish).

shoe_care_mat.doc: Protective sheet to polish shoes on.

sewing_kit.doc: Sewing kit box (needles, threads, buttons, snips).

sewing_needle.doc: Hand-sewing needle (sharp; pinch grip; 0.8 mm eye).

fine_needle.doc: Fine sharps needle (0.5 mm eye; frayed thread will not pass).

thread_spool.doc: Spool of all-purpose polyester thread (100 m).

garment_pocket.doc: A pocket on a garment (open it to check; contents hide inside). Its cloth holds no liquid (watertight false: kernel pours, spills, drips and rain soak through an open pocket instead of pooling in it).

props.label: wall hooks for the ironing board and drying rack

laundry_wall_hooks.doc: Wall-mounted pair of padded hooks at 1.45 m: a folded ironing board and a folded drying rack hang flat against the wall below them (thin, so the floor in front stays walkable). Lift them off to set them up.

jacket.doc: Denim jacket (adult M about 0.8 kg; the generic mid-season jacket of the sweep's type request; light_jacket and puffer_jacket are the shell and down variants).

notes: SPOT CLEAN COVER WITH WATER-BASED CLEANER (CODE W)

sofa_cushion.doc: Loose sofa seat or back cushion: foam core in a sewn-on polyester cover (60 x 60 x 15 cm, 1.4 kg; spot clean only). Lifted to look under it or to vacuum the deck.

seat_cushion.doc: Tie-on dining-chair seat pad (40 x 40 x 4 cm foam in a polyester cover, 0.3 kg; machine washable cold on gentle, dry flat).

laundry_jug.doc: Members are sold in the same 2.5 L household jug (a full jug looks, hefts and sloshes alike whatever is in it: the label tells them apart; red-team round 5 found the litres an inspection estimates told them apart). Every member type carries the same jug props -- size_m, volume_l, empty mass_kg, liquid_l, capacity_l, shape, com_frac, mouth_frac -- so no camera pixel, contact, pour or tip tells them apart before the label is read (independent review L2/L4: the bleach jug was 0.30 m tall and a bottle-shaped cylinder, the booster 0.20 m)
